title: Voqalize widget configuration
description: One object configures the widget: as element attributes, as the element's config property, as the builder's output and as the Site Agent's widget settings. Every field is optional. A field this version does not know is ignored, so a configuration saved by a newer builder still loads. Each default here is the one the widget uses when the field is left out.

agent.description: The agent's id. With `key`, the widget mints its own session from the page.

key.description: A publishable key for `agent`. Never a secret key: this sits in page source.

name.description: The agent's name as the widget's words say it, as in "Talk to {name}".

avatar.description: The face. `false` makes a voice-only widget, with a waveform in place of the face.

character.description: A character from the avatar catalogue. Left out, the agent's own character.

background.description: Behind the transparent face: "none", a CSS colour or gradient, or the URL of an image, GIF or muted looping video with how it fits. Characters built from a photograph carry their own backdrop, so a background shows only outside their frame.

still.description: An image shown until the face draws. Left out, the character's own still.

mode.description: corner floats over the page; inline renders inside the host element; fullscreen covers the viewport.

move.description: snap: dragged freely, released to the nearest anchor. free: stays where dropped. fixed: does not move. Touch screens only snap.

remember.description: Where a moved widget's place is kept: this tab, every tab of this site, or nowhere.

offset.description: Distance from the viewport's edges in px, one number or per axis. 16 is the Site Agent snippet's margin.

avoid.description: CSS selectors of page elements the widget keeps clear of, besides anything marked data-vql-avoid.

topClear.description: Height in px at the top of the viewport the widget never covers, such as a sticky header.

style.description: The closed form. none: the page opens the widget with its own button.

autoCollapse.description: Collapse by itself when the page is cramped.

breakpoint.description: The viewport width in px below which the phone form is used. 480 is where the Site Agent snippet's tile stops fitting beside page content.

devices.description: The mic and speaker menu. Shown on desktop only: phones switch audio routes themselves.

instantStart.description: Connect on the click while the browser is still asking for the mic. Off waits for the prompt first.

silenceHint.description: Say so when the mic is live but has heard nothing while the agent waits.

linger.description: How long the captions stay after the agent stops: a duration such as "4s" or "800ms", or a number of milliseconds.

showUser.description: A faint line with what the visitor said.

ink.description: The text colour. Repaired for contrast against the background.

font.description: "inherit" takes the page's font; anything else is a font-family value.

words.description: The widget's words, per BCP-47 tag, by key ("launcher.label"). A word left out falls back to English, and English to the built-in words.

dir.description: Text direction. auto follows the language.
